Resolves #21060

Reconciles `aria-pressed` in `Neo.button.Base` through a shared `syncAriaPressedState()` helper invoked from `afterSetPressed`, `afterSetRole`, and `updateTag()`. `aria-pressed` now renders only when the effective root tag is `button`, the ARIA `role` is unset or `button`, and `pressed` is non-null; navigation links (`url` or non-editing `route`) omit `aria-pressed` while keeping `.pressed` styling and `href`, and clearing link navigation restores `aria-pressed` matching the stored `pressed` value.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit suite across `test/playwright/unit/button/` and `test/playwright/unit/tab/`) → L1 required (AC-1..AC-3 VDOM ARIA attribute transitions and existing button/tab suite checks).

Micro-review eligible: contained — single-class ARIA attribute reconciliation in `Neo.button.Base` with focused unit regressions.

| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/button/AriaPressed.spec.mjs` (`button to link and back restores aria-pressed matching pressed state while plain buttons keep it absent` — verifies `button` → `a` (`url` and `route`) → `button` round-trips restore `aria-pressed` (`'true'` / `'false'`), plain buttons stay attribute-free, and routed tab headers keep `aria-selected` without `aria-pressed`) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/button/ test/playwright/unit/tab/` (`156 passed`) |

### `@neo-opus-ada` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-16T08:22:15Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — one class (`Neo.button.Base`), one reconciler and three call sites, plus a focused unit spec. It corrects ARIA semantics and adds no abstraction, consumed contract or fleet-critical surface.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** #21060's premise holds on `dev`: `afterSetPressed` wrote `aria-pressed` whatever the root tag was, and `updateTag` switched between `button` and `a` without reconciling it. The patch moves the write into `syncAriaPressedState()`, which `afterSetPressed`, `afterSetRole` and `updateTag` all call. So the attribute follows tag, role and pressed value in any config order, and each transition still sends one update: the reconciler only writes VDOM, and `updatePressedCls`, `changeVdomRootKey` and `updateTag` publish. I verified against exact head `54f0c0472a`:
- `super.afterSetRole` exists (`src/component/Base.mjs:895`).
- Tab headers (role `tab`) and grid headers (role `columnheader`) now lose the attribute on every path, as ARIA requires.
- As a falsifier I dropped the role gate `(!role || role === 'button')` at the head. 2 of 156 button and tab tests failed ("a tab header renders aria-selected and no aria-pressed", "button to link and back…"), so the gate is covered.

Bounded repair: the role gate is the ticket Fix's own "consistent with the rendered role", in the one class it names; no other site is touched. What I looked for and did not find: a caller combining `role: 'button'` with `url` or `route`. An `<a role="button">` would lose `aria-pressed` here although WAI-ARIA allows it there, but nothing in `src/` builds one.

**Findings:** None.
